description: REVTeX 4.2 (4.2f, June 2022, CTAN/MiKTeX package revtex) with its AIP substyle aip4-2.rtx for J. Chem. Phys. (jcp), in the two-column reprint format. aip picks the society and jcp the journal (superscript numbered citations, aipnum4-2.bst). reprint is set explicitly because AIP's default, unlike APS's, is preprint (one column, 12pt).
